name: Front
description: Support and Helpdesk: shared-inbox customer communication platform combining email, messaging channels and team collaboration.
access_notes: Self-serve product trial, plus free developer accounts offered via the developer portal for building/testing. API tokens are created self-serve in Settings > Developers. OAuth (authorization code, with refresh tokens) is required for public integrations distributed via the Front App Store; API tokens are fine for private integrations.
mcp_notes: Official first-party Front MCP server in open beta at https://mcp.frontapp.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, user-scoped permissions; Claude directory listing available; free during open beta). No Composio Front toolkit found: docs.composio.dev/toolkits/front and composio.dev/toolkits/frontapp return 404, and composio.dev/toolkits/front falls back to a category page.
uncertainty_notes: Vendor MCP is open beta ('tool names subject to change', pricing subject to change after beta). Front's platform also includes Channel API, Plugin SDK and no-code Connectors beyond the Core REST API.

evidence.note: Core API uses Bearer tokens; two ways to get one: self-serve API tokens in settings or OAuth; OAuth required for public integrations.
OAuth authorization-code flow at app.frontapp.com/oauth/authorize and /oauth/token; access tokens last 60 minutes, refresh tokens 6 months.
API tokens created self-serve under Settings > Developers > API Tokens; getting-started guide also points to free developer accounts.
Official Front MCP server (open beta) at mcp.frontapp.com/mcp; OAuth-authenticated, user-scoped authorization.
Developer portal lists Core API (REST), MCP Server, Connectors, Plugin SDK and Channel API; Core API supports webhook-based event notifications via application webhooks and rules.
